des.oror_supreme_bosses.gun.charging: Charging %s / %s FE: cannot fire until full
item.oror_supreme_bosses.blueprinter.des: Scans a building and prints it anywhere
Sneak + use: switch between scan and print
Scan: use on two opposite corner blocks (reaches 64 blocks; up to 64 per side)
Print: use on a spot to see where it goes, again to print (reaches 256 blocks; turned the way you face)
item.oror_supreme_bosses.focus_cell.desc: Ammunition for the laser gun "Shinbatsu": one per shot
The light of two end crystals, sealed for one shot
item.oror_supreme_bosses.kingslayer.desc: Shatters the Villager King's ward in one blow (10 s)
Every blow at the king draws its bearer's blood too
Eats at the life of whoever holds it (Wither, Hunger)
item.oror_supreme_bosses.laser_gun.desc1: Fires only when fully charged, once: every shot empties it
item.oror_supreme_bosses.laser_gun.desc2: A thick 256-block beam: passes glass and ice, burns everything it touches and leaves it glowing, slowed and weakened
item.oror_supreme_bosses.laser_gun.desc3: A five-block blast at the focus (no terrain damage). Ammo: Focus Cell, one per shot
item.oror_supreme_bosses.laser_gun.desc4: Holds 600,000 FE: fill it at a charging station before each shot
item.oror_supreme_bosses.matter_cartridg: What the Blueprinter prints with: 256 units each
A plain block is 1 unit; one with a block entity or a costly one 16; air is free
item.oror_supreme_bosses.mels_castle.des: Use it on the ground: a castle rises before you (64 by 64, walls, towers, halls, villagers and guards).
Stone footings fill in under it where the ground falls away. Used once.
Left to whoever beat Mels, the Supreme Martial King.
item.oror_supreme_bosses.rail_slug.desc1: Ammunition for the railgun "Amaugachi": one per shot
item.oror_supreme_bosses.rail_slug.desc2: A netherite core wound in cemented carbide, spent in one shot
item.oror_supreme_bosses.railgun.desc1: Fires only when fully charged, once: every shot empties it
item.oror_supreme_bosses.railgun.desc2: A magnetic slug out to 512 blocks: passes up to 32 blocks softer than obsidian and hits everyone on its line, ignoring armour
item.oror_supreme_bosses.railgun.desc3: A shock wave where it lands (no terrain damage). Ammo: Tungsten Rail Slug, one per shot
item.oror_supreme_bosses.railgun.desc4: Holds 1,000,000 FE: fill it at a charging station before each shot
item.oror_supreme_bosses.rebel_certifica: Carried, the illagers, piglins and endermen spare you; shown, they trade.
Hold it and speak to a wandering trader: a map to the rebels' city.
Sealed in villagers' blood: the mark of one who turns on the king.
item.oror_supreme_bosses.villager_blood_: Use paper on a villager while sneaking.
A villager made to cut his finger and press his seal.
That villager will not trust you again.
Mending needs a level of experience
message.oror_supreme_bosses.starter_kit: You received a starter kit: a set of iron armour, 16 steaks, a Glock 17 and 96 handgun rounds. Right-click the rounds to load them as ammunition.
oror.blueprinter.busy: Wait for the last print to finish
oror.blueprinter.corner_a: First corner (%s, %s, %s). Use on the opposite corner to scan
oror.blueprinter.denied: Cannot print here (protected area, world border or height limit)
oror.blueprinter.done: Print finished: %s blocks placed (%s existing blocks kept)
oror.blueprinter.missing: This blueprint's data is not in this world
oror.blueprinter.no_blueprint: No blueprint: scan a building in scan mode first
oror.blueprinter.preview: Prints here: %s×%s×%s (%s cartridges). Use the same spot again within ten seconds to print
oror.blueprinter.scanned: Scanned %s×%s×%s, %s blocks; printing takes %s Matter Cartridges. Switched to print mode
oror.blueprinter.too_large: Too large: %s×%s×%s (up to %s blocks per side)
oror.patch.setup_missing: %s is not installed. Quit the game and run SETUP_NIGHTFALL.cmd in this profile's folder once (Indestructible comes in the import's mods folder).

tooltip.oror_supreme_bosses.placeable.dr: Sneak + use to set it down: it lights the place and burning furnaces within 3 blocks smelt twice as fast (hit it to take it back)
tooltip.oror_supreme_bosses.placeable.fo: Sneak + use to set it down: a repair station - use a worn tool, weapon or armour on it to mend a quarter (one level)
tooltip.oror_supreme_bosses.placeable.om: Sneak + use to set it down: its armillary turns slowly and gives light (hit it to take it back)
tooltip.oror_supreme_bosses.placeable.sq: Sneak + use to plant it: the band within 12 blocks get Strength and Resistance (hit it to take it back)
tooltip.oror_supreme_bosses.placeable.st: Sneak + use to set it down: it shines, and those within 8 blocks get Haste (hit it to take it back)
tooltip.oror_supreme_bosses.worn.dodge_t: Curio [hands: on the right hand]: dodges a blow or a shot, a leap to the side (every 3 s)
tooltip.oror_supreme_bosses.worn.last_bl: Curio [head: in the hair]: stops one blow that would kill (every 3 min)
tooltip.oror_supreme_bosses.worn.parry_e: Curio [bracelet: a buckler on the left arm]: parries a melee blow from the front and answers it (every 5 s)
tooltip.oror_supreme_bosses.worn.rewind_: Curio [necklace]: turns back one blow that would kill (the talisman breaks)
tooltip.oror_supreme_bosses.worn.squad_b: Curio [back: a banner on the back]: in a fight, rallies the band within 12 blocks (healed, Strength IV, Resistance III; every 30 s)
tooltip.oror_supreme_bosses.worn.village: Curio [necklace]: Hero of the Village II while worn
